translation: The mountain-corner bone (山角骨) is the ridged bone on the two sides of the top of the head. In all cases of injury from falls and blows where the skin is not broken, whether left or right, with blue-purple swelling and hardness, congealed stagnant blood and pain, or coma with eyes closed, the body soft and unable to rise, breath and voice short and scanty, speech not coming out, the heart flustered and disordered, sleeping and lying with panting, and eating and drinking little, one should internally take Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹), and externally use the moxibustion-ironing method as in the treatment of fontanel bone injury. If the flesh is broken and blood flows without stopping, first use horse's puffball ash (馬屁勃灰) to stop the blood, then cover the wound with elm bark (榆樹皮), and moxa with Ai He Ding Tong San (艾合定痛散).
